mapper.select: INSERT INTO auth_identity (user_id, provider, provider_subject) VALUES ( #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{providerSubject, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) RETURNING id

SELECT authentication_identity.id AS auth_identity_id, authentication_identity.user_id, authentication_identity.provider_subject AS normalized_email, password_credential.password_verifier FROM auth_identity authentication_identity JOIN local_password_credential password_credential ON password_credential.auth_identity_id = authentication_identity.id WHERE authentication_identity.provider = #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND authentication_identity.provider_subject = #{providerSubject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
